title: helopus globosus
intro: Helopus globosus, commonly known as the African helopus, is a plant species that belongs to the family Annonaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Helopus globosus are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which may help in reducing pain, inflammation, and the severity of certain infections. The bioactive constituents of Helopus globosus include lignans, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
